channel.title: With Raspberry Pi
channel.description: Master Raspberry Pi with our comprehensive tutorials covering setup, programming, troubleshooting, and advanced projects. Perfect for beginners and experts alike.

item.title: Arm64 Assembly Programming
item.description: Arm64 Assembly Programming. Explore ARM64 concepts, instructions, code examples, debugging techniques, and Raspberry Pi performance considerations.

item.title: AArch64 ADRP, ADD, ADR, and LDR Literal Explained
item.description: Understand AArch64 ADRP plus ADD, ADR, LDR literal, and the LDR equals pseudo-instruction. Includes ranges, relocations, disassembly, and Raspberry Pi examples.

item.title: Arm64 Registers and Basic Instructions
item.description: Arm64 Registers and Basic Instructions. Explore ARM64 concepts, instructions, code examples, debugging techniques, and Raspberry Pi performance considerations.

item.title: Raspberry Pi NetworkManager and nmcli Guide
item.description: Configure Raspberry Pi networking on Trixie with NetworkManager and nmcli. Covers Wi-Fi, Ethernet, static IP, DNS, routes, diagnostics, and safe remote changes.

item.title: User and Permission Management for Raspberry Pi
item.description: Master user and permission management on Raspberry Pi. Learn account creation, sudo configuration, group management, SSH key setup, and security best practices.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Setup Guide 2026: Imager and SSH
item.description: Set up Raspberry Pi OS in 2026 with Imager. Covers 64-bit OS selection, Wi-Fi, SSH keys, headless first boot, updates, security, and troubleshooting steps.

item.title: Tips & Advanced Techniques
item.description: Tips & Advanced Techniques. Follow practical Raspberry Pi setup steps, configuration examples, best practices, security guidance, and troubleshooting tips.

item.title: Raspberry Pi USB OTG Mass-Storage Gadget
item.description: Configure Raspberry Pi USB OTG mass storage and compare it with USB Gadget networking. Covers supported models, backing files, access safety, and recovery.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Headless and Networking Guide 2026
item.description: Choose the best Raspberry Pi headless connection in 2026. Compare Wi-Fi, Ethernet, USB Gadget, SSH, Connect, Tailscale, VNC, static IP, and recovery paths.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Headless Setup 2026 with Imager and SSH
item.description: Set up Raspberry Pi headless in 2026 with Imager, Wi-Fi, SSH keys, Ethernet, or USB Gadget Mode. Includes first-boot checks, discovery, security, and recovery.

item.title: Raspberry Pi OS Trixie Security Hardening
item.description: Harden Raspberry Pi OS Trixie with updates, admin passwords, SSH keys, firewall rules, least privilege, automatic upgrades, auditing, backups, and recovery.

item.title: Raspberry Pi USB Gadget Mode 2026: SSH over USB
item.description: Set up Raspberry Pi USB Gadget Mode on Trixie for SSH over one USB cable. Covers Imager, rpi-usb-gadget, supported models, Windows, macOS, Linux, and fixes.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Wi-Fi Access Point with NetworkManager
item.description: Create a Raspberry Pi Wi-Fi access point with NetworkManager on Trixie. Compare hotspot, routed NAT, and bridged AP modes with security and troubleshooting.

item.title: Run Ultralytics YOLO on Raspberry Pi with OpenVINO
item.description: Run Ultralytics YOLO with OpenVINO on Raspberry Pi 4 or 5. Install Arm64 wheels, export models, enable caching, benchmark latency and FPS, and deploy safely.

item.title: Manual USB Ethernet Gadget with dwc2 and g_ether
item.description: Build a manual Raspberry Pi USB Ethernet gadget with dwc2 and g_ether when the Trixie package is unsuitable. Covers static IP, SSH, host setup, and recovery.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description: Frequently asked questions about Raspberry Pi. Covers hardware, software, networking, performance, storage, and troubleshooting with detailed solutions.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Configuration Commands with raspi-config
item.description: Configure Raspberry Pi OS with raspi-config and CLI tools. Covers Trixie paths, SSH, Wi-Fi, locale, boot, interfaces, and troubleshooting commands safely.

item.title: Chromium Sync on Raspberry Pi: Chrome ARM64
item.description: Chromium on Raspberry Pi cannot use Google Account sync. Check current Chrome ARM64 support and compare bookmark, password, and full-browser sync alternatives.

item.title: llama.cpp on Raspberry Pi: Build and Benchmark
item.description: Run llama.cpp on Raspberry Pi with current CMake commands. Choose GGUF models, tune threads and context, use --mlock, benchmark tokens/s, and serve a local API.

item.title: Raspberry Pi OverlayFS: Read-Only Root and Kiosk
item.description: Set up OverlayFS on Raspberry Pi for a read-only root, kiosk, or test system. Learn lower, upper, work and merged directories, persistence, and recovery.
